parts.text: {"title": "Guide", "sections": [{"heading": "Certificate rotation", "text": "The signing certificate rotates every ninety days. The rotation runs without a restart of the service. An expired certificate is refused at sign-in with a clear message. The platform team is paged when a rotation fails.", "sources": ["doc-certificate"]}, {"heading": "Roadmap review", "text": "The quarterly roadmap review happens in the last week of each quarter. The sponsor chairs the review and the hub owners present. The review ends with a ranked list of themes for the next quarter. The ranked list is published", "sources": ["doc-roadmap"]}, {"heading": "Incident runbook", "text": "Alerts page the on-call engineer through the paging service. The on-call rota changes every Sunday at 09:00. After fifteen minutes without acknowledgement the lead is paged. After thirty minutes a bridge call is opened and the status page is updated.", "sources": ["doc-runbook"]}], "empty_reason": null, "rationale": "One section per source, in the sources' own words."}
